system.description:
As a requirement of casting this jutsu you must target a Prone creature. This jutsu can only be cast as a Finisher.

You raise your hand to the sky, beckoning the heavens and projecting your essence of self. You create a direct fissure through the Prone target with a single blow.

Make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, you deal 8d12 +30 bludgeoning damage.

Regardless of a hit or miss, all creatures, excluding you and the original target, must make a dexterity saving throw taking 8d8 + 15 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
